D.comparison: CAL, DGBL, and emerging technologies-enabled learning

O.outcome_detail: alignment with GAF access to assets

result.effect: 43% vs CAL 21%, DGBL 17%, emerging technologies-enabled learning 0%

cells.quote: When comparing different approaches in the reviewed studies, it is found that mobile-enabled learning (43%) leads to more access to assets in this review, followed by CAL (21%) and DGBL (17%);
cells.note: The percentages are proportions of reviewed studies aligned with the GAF dimension, not causal effect sizes.
